scope: CPU constructed workload using exact Terminal-Bench snapshot fingerprints and observed natural EOS lengths. Fixed per-domain cache salts separate independent copies of unchanged prompts. Each request is an independent replay of its complete source prompt history. Cold preparation is timed.

paired_clients.rule: Send two simultaneous requests for the same namespace and snapshot. Wait for both D first tokens and the minimum pair interval before posting the next pair. The plan and EOS work are frozen. Actual releases follow first-token completions. Routing uses unchanged native scores.
